title: Wire the Run Workflow to dispatch per-tick workers
description:
The call site for 0ds. dispatchWave exists, is tested and is reachable from nothing — the Run Workflow still boots one orchestrator sandbox that fans out harness-native subagents inside itself. This tick makes substrate = cloud actually mean per-tick containers for a wave.

Depends on kx8 (a worker has to have an entrypoint to boot). Respect what wave 3 measured: max_instances = 3 is a deployment ceiling that silently serialises a wider wave, so either raise it as a deployment decision bounded by the account container limits or cap the wave at it and say so; and kji enforces [orchestration].max_parallel on the claim, so the two limits must not disagree silently.
notes:
2026-08-21 21:00 - The integration point where 0ds and tap meet. 0ds landed cloud/factory/src/worker-dispatch.ts (probe, confirmed dispatch, expiring liveness, dispatchWave, git-only collect, 39 tests) and tap landed the worker container entrypoint plus the marker the probe checks for. Neither is reachable from a run today: the Run Workflow still boots ONE orchestrator sandbox that fans out harness-native subagents inside itself.

Do not re-derive what wave 3 measured. max_instances = 3 is a deployment ceiling that will silently SERIALISE a wider wave — either raise it as a deployment decision bounded by the account's container limits, or cap the wave at it and say so out loud; a wave that quietly runs three at a time when the operator asked for six is the same class of defect as kji. kji enforces [orchestration].max_parallel on the CLAIM, so the two limits must not disagree silently — decide which is authoritative and make the other defer to it. On Cloudflare an image belongs to the containers application rather than a boot (x3v), so workers run the same image as the orchestrator and must be told which role they are playing. Cost is not a constraint: a fully cold wave of six is 2.5 cents (kuf), but per-sandbox time degrades 3.74x at N=5 with ALL of the degradation in dependency install, so that is the thing to design around.

The run must still work when substrate is not cloud — this is an added path, not a replacement.
